import Link from "next/link"
import { notFound } from "next/navigation"
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Check, Phone } from "lucide-react"

interface PageProps {
    params: {
        categorySlug: string
        serviceSlug: string
    }
}

export const revalidate = 3600

export default async function ServiceDetailPage({ params }: PageProps) {
    const { categorySlug, serviceSlug } = params
    const supabase = await createClient()

    // Fetch Service Details
    const { data: service } = await supabase
        .from('services')
        .select(`
      *,
      category:service_categories(name, slug)
    `)
        .eq('slug', serviceSlug)
        .single()

    if (!service) {
        notFound()
    }

    const features = Array.isArray(service.features_json) ? service.features_json : []

    return (
        <div className="container py-10 max-w-4xl">
            <div className="mb-8">
                <Link
                    href={`/services/${categorySlug}`}
                    className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary mb-4 inline-block"
                >
                    &larr; Back to {service.category?.name || "Plans"}
                </Link>
                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
                    <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary sm:text-4xl">{service.name}</h1>
                    <div className="text-2xl font-bold bg-primary/10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md text-primary">
                        {service.price ? `R${service.price} p/m` : 'Custom Pricing'}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
                <div className="md:col-span-2 space-y-8">
                    <div className="prose max-w-none text-muted-foreground">
                        <h3 className="text-foreground text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Description</h3>
                        <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{service.description || "No description provided."}</p>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                        <h3 className="text-foreground text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Plan Features</h3>
                        <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                            {features.map((feature: any, idx: number) => (
                                <div key={idx} className="flex items-start p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card">
                                    <Check className="mr-3 h-5 w-5 text-primary shrink-0" />
                                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{feature}</span>
                                </div>
                            ))}
                            {features.length === 0 && <p className="text-muted-foreground italic">No specific features listed.</p>}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-6">

## File: Tlou-Funeral-homes/client/app/services/[categorySlug]/page.tsx
````typescript
import Link from "next/link"
import { notFound } from "next/navigation"
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Check } from "lucide-react"

interface PageProps {
    params: {
        categorySlug: string
    }
}

export const revalidate = 3600

export default async function ServiceCategoryPage({ params }: PageProps) {
    const { categorySlug } = params
    const supabase = await createClient()

    // 1. Fetch Category
    const { data: category } = await supabase
        .from('service_categories')
        .select('*')
        .eq('slug', categorySlug)
        .single()

    if (!category) {
        notFound()
    }

    // 2. Fetch Services in Category
    const { data: services } = await supabase
        .from('services')
        .select('*')
        .eq('category_id', category.id)
        .order('price', { ascending: true }) // Assuming cheaper plans first

    return (
        <div className="container py-10 space-y-10">
            <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <Link href="/services" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary">
                        &larr; Back to Categories
                    </Link>
                    <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-primary sm:text-4xl">{category.name}</h1>
                </div>
                <p className="text-lg text-muted-foreground max-w-3xl">
                    {category.description}
                </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid gap-8 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
                {services?.map((service) => {
                    // Parse features JSON safely
                    // It might be stored as array or string in JSONB, handling array here
                    const features = Array.isArray(service.features_json)
                        ? service.features_json
                        : typeof service.features_json === 'string'
                            ? [service.features_json]
                            : []

                    return (
                        <Card key={service.id} className="flex flex-col border-primary/20 hover:border-primary/50 transition-all">
                            <CardHeader className="bg-muted/10 pb-4">
                                <CardTitle className="text-xl text-primary">{service.name}</CardTitle>
                                <CardDescription className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground mt-2">
                                    {service.price ? `R${service.price} / Month` : 'Contact for Pricing'}
                                </CardDescription>
                            </CardHeader>
                            <CardContent className="flex-1 pt-6">
                                {features.length > 0 && (
                                    <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                                        {features.slice(0, 6).map((feature: any, idx: number) => (
                                            <li key={idx} className="flex items-start">
                                                <Check className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
                                                <span>{feature}</span>
                                            </li>
                                        ))}
                                        {features.length > 6 && (
                                            <li className="text-xs text-primary pt-1">+{features.length - 6} more features</li>
                                        )}
                                    </ul>
                                )}
                                {!features.length && service.description && (
                                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-4">{service.description}</p>
                                )}
                            </CardContent>
                            <CardFooter className="pt-4 border-t bg-muted/5">
                                <Button className="w-full" asChild>
                                    <Link href={`/services/${categorySlug}/${service.slug}`}>
                                        View Details
                                    </Link>
                                </Button>
                            </CardFooter>
                        </Card>
                    )
                })}
                {(!services || services.length === 0) && (
                    <div className="col-span-full py-12 text-center border rounded-lg border-dashed">
                        <p className="text-muted-foreground">No plans available in this category yet.</p>
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    )
}
````

export function Navbar() {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)

    const routes = [
        { href: "/", label: "Home" },
        { href: "/about", label: "About Us" },
        { href: "/services", label: "Services" },
        { href: "/contact", label: "Contact" },
    ]

    return (
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60">
            <div className="container flex h-16 items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Link href="/" className="font-bold text-xl tracking-tight text-primary">
                        TLOU FUNERAL HOMES
                    </Link>
                </div>

                {/* Desktop Nav */}
                <nav className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-6">
                    {routes.map(route => (
                        <Link
                            key={route.href}
                            href={route.href}
                            className="text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:text-primary"
                        >
                            {route.label}
                        </Link>
                    ))}
                    <Button asChild className="bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90">
                        <Link href="/contact">Get Coverage</Link>
                    </Button>
                </nav>

                    <Sheet open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
                        <SheetTrigger asChild>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon">
                                <Menu className="h-6 w-6" />
                            </Button>
                        </SheetTrigger>
                        <SheetContent side="right">
                            <SheetHeader>
                                <SheetTitle className="text-left">Menu</SheetTitle>
                            </SheetHeader>
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 mt-6">
                                {routes.map(route => (
                                    <Link
                                        key={route.href}
                                        href={route.href}
                                        onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
                                        className="text-lg font-medium transition-colors hover:text-primary"
                                    >
                                        {route.label}
                                    </Link>
                                ))}
                                <Button asChild className="bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 mt-4 w-full">
                                    <Link href="/contact" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
                                        Get Coverage
                                    </Link>
                                </Button>
                            </div>
                        </SheetContent>
                    </Sheet>
                </div>
            </div>
        </header>
    )
}

import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
    "inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
    {
        variants: {
            variant: {
                default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90",
                destructive:
                    "bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90",
                outline:
                    "border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
                secondary:
                    "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80",
                ghost: "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
                link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
            },
            size: {
                default: "h-10 px-4 py-2",
                sm: "h-9 rounded-md px-3",
                lg: "h-11 rounded-md px-8",
                icon: "h-10 w-10",
            },
        },
        defaultVariants: {
            variant: "default",
            size: "default",
        },
    }
)

export interface ButtonProps
    extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
    asChild?: boolean
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
    ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
        const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
        return (
            <Comp
                className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
                ref={ref}
                {...props}
            />
        )
    }
)
Button.displayName = "Button"

export { Button, buttonVariants }

````typescript
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export async function createClient() {
    const cookieStore = await cookies()

    return createServerClient(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
        {
            cookies: {
                getAll() {
                    return cookieStore.getAll()
                },
                /**
                 * Explicitly defining the type for cookiesToSet.
                 * Each item contains the name, value, and cookie options.
                 */
                setAll(cookiesToSet: { name: string; value: string; options: CookieOptions }[]) {
                    try {
                        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
                            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
                        )
                    } catch {
                        // The `setAll` method was called from a Server Component.
                        // This can be ignored if you have middleware refreshing user sessions.
                    }
                },
            },
        }
    )
}
````

## File: Tlou-Funeral-homes/client/proxy.ts
````typescript
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
    let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
        request,
    })

    const supabase = createServerClient(
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
        process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
        {
            cookies: {
                getAll() {
                    return request.cookies.getAll()
                },
                setAll(cookiesToSet: { name: string; value: string; options: CookieOptions }[]) {
                    cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
                        request.cookies.set(name, value)
                    )
                    supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({
                        request,
                    })
                    cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
                        supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options)
                    )
                },
            },
        }
    )

    // Refresh session if expired
    await supabase.auth.getUser()

    return supabaseResponse
}

export const config = {
    matcher: [
        /*
         * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with:
         * - _next/static (static files)
         * - _next/image (image optimization files)
         * - favicon.ico (favicon file)
         * - images - .svg, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp
         * Feel free to modify this pattern to include more paths.
         */
        '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp)$).*)',
    ],
}
````

## File: Tlou-Funeral-homes/doc/Tlou/context.md
````markdown
## 1. Funeral Service Packages

Tlou offers four main tiers of funeral plans. All plans require a **Joining Fee of R100.00** and have a **6-month waiting period**.

| Feature | **Bronze** | **Silver** | **Gold** | **Platinum** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Casket Type** | Quarter View | Quarter View | Half View | Standard Dome |
| **Monthly Premium** | R230 (Member + 9) | R290 (Member + 9) | R360 (Member + 13) | R280 (Spouse + Kids) |
| **Programs** | 50 | 70 | 100 | 150 |
| **Flowers** | Coffin Spray | Coffin Spray | Fresh Flowers | Fresh Flowers |
| **Home Setup** | Tent, 50 Chairs, 2 Tables, Toilet | Mini Decor, 70 Chairs, A1 Photo | Mini Decor, 70 Chairs, A1 Photo | Home Decor, A1x2 Photos, 120 Chairs |
| **Transport** | 1 Hearse, 1 Family Car, Bus | 1 Hearse, 2 Family Cars | 1 Hearse, 2 Family Cars, Bus | 1 Hearse, 3 Family Cars, Bus |
| **Cashback (No Service)** | R1,900 | R2,100 | R2,500 | R3,000 |

*Note: The Platinum plan is listed at R280 for Member + Spouse (under 65) + Children (under 21).*

---

## 2. Optional Extra Benefits (Top-up covers)

* **Sound System:** @R1500.00
* **3 x TV Screens (Photo Slideshow):** @R2500.00
* **Catering:** @R110 P/M (Per Month)
* **Funeral Grocery Benefits:** @R120 P/M

---

## 3. Important Terms and Conditions

* **Payment:** Premiums must be paid on or before the **7th of each month**.
* **Lapsing:** If premiums are not paid for **3 months**, the policy is automatically cancelled.
* **Reinstatement:** Renewing a lapsed policy triggers a new **3-month waiting period**.
* **Crossover:** No waiting period applies if you are moving to Tlou from another funeral parlour.
* **Mileage:** Collection and burial are free within a **200km radius**. Beyond that, a fee of **R7.50 per kilometer** applies.
* **Cash Funerals:** Services are available for cash even if you are not a registered member.

---

## 4. Contact and Locations

**Offices:**

* **Embalenhle (Mpumalanga):** Erf 14519 Ext 15, 2285.
* **Limpopo:** Ref 50640 Glen Cowie, Jane Furse.
* **Piet Retief (Mpumalanga):** 05 Joubert Street.
* **Evander:** 24 Cornell Road (Next to Auto Zone).

**Contact Details:**

* **Phone:** 017 170 5225 / 071 075 0967 / 071 499 4240 (Bobo)
* **WhatsApp:** 060 697 5118
* **Email:** Tloufuneralservices@gmail.com
* **Facebook:** Tlou Funeral Homes

---
````
